rule: Each source is a contextual projection on one or more method facets, not a wholesale replacement candidate.

perspective-guided questions before deep search; dynamic conceptual map
separate search/gather/synthesis; query-conditioned evidence reranking; redundant metadata resolution

progressive tree search over research branches
persistent cross-session experiment/failure memory with separate research and execution layers

tree-search workflow challengers under frozen RAKLBench gates
choose questions/queries/experiments for expected information gain rather than passive search volume
allow non-constitutional meta-objectives to evolve when proxy metrics saturate or mislead
fast inner loop for stable quantitative objectives

entries.retained_projection: atomic capability benchmarks before end-to-end autonomy claims
multi-benchmark evaluation of research capabilities and compute efficiency
evaluate sustained research ability rather than only short tasks
model criticism is part of research, and diagnostically useful models need not become final conclusions
measure which compatible atomic choices drive conclusion sensitivity without brute-forcing impossible combinations
formal inspiration for Knowledge Atlas overlap compatibility and gluing
diagnostic estimate of remaining semantic novelty; never a saturation certificate under adaptive search
store support under explicit assumption environments, preserve simultaneous candidate worlds, and identify inconsistent assumption combinations instead of retracting history globally

entries.retained_projection: make attack relations between claims/arguments first-class and compute acceptability from graph structure rather than prose consensus
entries.cannot_see: an abstract attack graph does not itself establish that an argument is source-grounded or scientifically valid

entries.retained_projection: structured argument trees provide inspectable paths and can outperform unstructured multi-model debate; RAKL should borrow structure but never promote model-generated arguments above source evidence
evaluate claim-to-evidence linkage atomically; multi-pass decomposition can improve evidence linking at added cost
benchmark sentence-level evidence retrieval against expert judgments rather than treating citation presence as grounding
decompose answers and sources into atomic claims/evidence so support gaps and omissions become visible; provenance visibility alone does not guarantee users will verify
use active-learning prioritization and simulation benchmarks to reduce screening cost while retaining explicit reviewer decisions
stopping must balance additional screening cost against the risk of missed relevant records and should combine multiple conservative diagnostics rather than one magic threshold
entries.cannot_see: document-recall stopping is not semantic saturation; RAKL still requires route-diverse semantic novelty checks

next_action: Implement and benchmark typed/scoped relation algebra first; then open assumption-environment truth maintenance, structured evidence argumentation, atomic claim-evidence provenance, and active-search stopping as separate fibers. Continue until route-wise and independent semantic novelty is flat.
